home.title: From the field to the decision: I design the whole journey of your production data.
home.lead: I build software that collects data from machines, moves it between systems without loss and turns it into decisions — PLC/SCADA integration, MES modules, real-time telemetry and data synchronization, backed by 8 years of experience.
home.diagramHint: Each layer links to the solutions built on it.
problems: We can't get data out of our machines — or we collect it by hand.
OEE and downtime are calculated in spreadsheets.
Production orders in the ERP don't match what happens on the floor.
Two databases drift apart and nightly jobs keep failing.
A legacy desktop app or Windows service that nobody dares to touch.
home.approachLead: Technology choices follow the questions below — not the other way around.
home.ctaTitle: Have a production line, an integration or a half-finished system?
home.ctaText: Tell me about it in a few sentences. A short call is usually enough to see whether I can help.

about.title: About
about.lead: An electrical & electronics engineer who writes software — someone who knows both ends of the cable.
story: I started on the field side: commissioning PLC-controlled machines, writing control logic in Structured Text and Ladder, and debugging on site.
Over time I moved up the stack — device communication services, MES modules, data synchronization platforms and dashboards — without losing sight of what happens on the shop floor.
Today I design systems that carry data from machines to decisions, with an emphasis on reliability, simplicity and testability.
about.mission: To turn machine data into reliable, traceable information that drives decisions.
about.vision: Production sites with no wall between OT and IT — where every machine can speak.
principles: Understand the field and the data first, then write code.
In 24/7 systems, fault tolerance is a requirement, not a feature.
Simulate first, then go to the field.
Prefer the simplest design that will still be understandable in three years.
